_comment: Shared reede-v2 receipt test vector. content_hash is SHA-256 over the injective encoding (<len_hex>:<bytes> per field) of 11 fields: tenant_id, task_id, payload_summary, credits_spent, tokens_used, reservation_credits, prev_hash (empty if null), sequence_no, timestamp (RFC 3339 UTC, exactly 6 fractional digits, Z), subject_id (empty if null), signer_key_id (empty if null). signature is Ed25519 over the content_hash ASCII bytes. The test-only signing key is the Ed25519 seed of 32 bytes of 0x07; signer_key_id is the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over pubkey. Generated independently of the Rust writer (Python hashlib + cryptography).
